note.zh-TW: 主管機關的財務分析格式（例如公開說明書）用最近五年合計；模板只算單期。教材口徑標「單期近似」，有多期資料時改用五年合計；分母為 0 一律 N/A。
note.en: The regulator’s financial analysis format (in prospectuses, for example) uses the latest five years in total; the template uses one period. The course version is marked as a single-period approximation and switches to the five-year total when the data exist; a zero denominator always gives N/A.

definition.zh-TW:
本業產生的現金夠不夠支付資本支出、存貨增加與股利這三項最基本的用途。

比率達到 {{percent:1|digits=0}} 以上，表示公司不必靠借款或增資就能支應自己的投資與分配。
definition.en:
Whether the cash generated by the main business is enough to cover three basic needs: capital expenditure, inventory build-up and dividends.

A ratio of {{percent:1|digits=0}} or more means the company can fund its investment and distributions without borrowing or raising new capital.

example.zh-TW: 分子與分母都來自現金流量表：分子是營業活動總計，分母取投資活動的取得非流動資產、營業活動的存貨增加與籌資活動的支付股息。存貨減少時不算進分母。
example.en: Every figure comes from the statement of cash flows: the numerator is net cash from operating activities, and the denominator gathers payments to acquire non-current assets, the increase in inventories and dividends paid. A decrease in inventories is not counted in the denominator.

misconception.zh-TW: 分母為 0 時把比率填成 0 或「無限大」。分母為 0 代表這個比率沒有定義，網站一律顯示 N/A；它和「算出來等於 0」是兩回事。
misconception.en: Writing the ratio as zero or infinity when the denominator is zero. A zero denominator means the ratio is undefined, so the site shows N/A; that is not the same as a ratio that works out to zero.

formula.zh-TW: 現金流量允當比率 ＝ 營業活動的現金流量總計 ÷（資本支出 ＋ 存貨增加額 ＋ 支付股息）。主管機關的財務分析格式用最近五年的合計；課程模板只用單期，網站標示「單期近似」。分母為 0 時一律顯示 N/A，分母為負時標示「不具解釋意義」。
formula.en: Cash flow adequacy ratio = net cash from operating activities ÷ (capital expenditure + increase in inventories + dividends paid). The regulator’s financial analysis format uses five-year totals; the course template uses a single period, which the site labels as a single-period approximation. When the denominator is zero the result is N/A; when it is negative the ratio is marked as not meaningful.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率，這個名稱是國際通用的說法；計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準，題目會指定用哪一個版本計分。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios; the name follows international usage. The calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry, and each question states which version it scores against.
